hardware: Apple M3 Pro, 11 CPU cores, 36 GiB RAM
compiler: Apple Clang (Xcode SDK MacOSX26.1), Release -O3 -DNDEBUG -march=armv8 C++17
metric: Cosine with standard CosineFp32Converter and matching query reformer; normalized 768-dimensional features plus one norm float
ground_truth: Exact float32 cosine on the 100000-vector subset (NumPy), top100; flat search strict ID recall at top10 verified as 100%
timing: Three serial paired rounds, orders main/current, current/main, main/current; 8 seconds per process after query warmup/validation. 1000 validation queries on first-round single-thread 512 MiB runs; 100 on the other runs. No compilation/index build concurrent with formal timings. Query reforming excluded from timed search.
cache: New process each run; OS page cache warm; BufferStorage/BufferReadStorage budgets 512 MiB, with 64 MiB graph cases
notes: Other desktop programs are active; use run ranges to assess noise.
Same fixed main-built indexes are used by both versions to isolate read migration; build throughput is not compared.
Vamana R=32,L=100,alpha=1.2,ef=200 has low baseline recall and is only a relative cost comparison.
Native ARM build excludes RaBitQ; full 1M is not tested.
64 MiB full 1000-query preflight was stopped after over 2 minutes; those measurements are excluded. Formal small-cache runs use 100 validation/warmup queries.
